name: newsh2-51
summary: A mechanical claw (right-hand; newsh2-49 mirrored): a hard-surface armoured arm that arches from a rounded purple housing at the top left, through a grey collar and a dark drum, over and down the right side into purple armour plates with a lattice bay and a grey spine rail ending in a point; from the housing's left end hang twin struts to a clevis knuckle and a glowing red claw tube. Hard panels with chamfered edges; the housing, collar, drum, struts and claw tube are round.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours
